coaching.headline: The team buried Valmont, twelve deaths and zero kills, then turned the 5-2 mid fight and the closing plays into structures.

flags.text: The Fey's damn 32154 hero damage led all ten players, with seven of nine kills on Valmont.
Structures went eight to zero: Greystone razed the enemy offlane outer, offlane inner and the Core.
After enemy Fangtooth, the team cashed Mini Prime, then two inner towers, then both inhibitors.
The shit part: The Fey and Khaimera died on mid, and enemy Fangtooth followed within a minute.

focus.title: Fangtooth first, mid trades second
focus.action: Before each Fangtooth, The Fey and Khaimera should skip mid trades while Aurora and Kira are unaccounted for, and after each won fight the team should hit the nearest tower.

16.2.call: Lost 0-2 on mid: Aurora killed The Fey and Kira killed Khaimera. The duo and offlane outers still fell, then enemy Fangtooth. With Fangtooth next, group at the pit instead.

17.2.call: Won 2-0 after enemy Fangtooth: Lt. Belica killed Kira on the duo lane in the allied half and The Fey killed Valmont on mid; Mini Prime went allied next. Right answer to a lost pit.

19.1.call: Won 5-2, the biggest fight of the game, opened by Khaimera killing Bayle at the Fangtooth pit; Greystone then razed the offlane inner and Sparrow the mid inner.

21.9.call: Two separate plays: Sparrow killed Kira on the duo lane, and Khaimera razed the mid inhibitor, then killed Valmont and Bayle in the enemy base before falling to Kira. Greystone razed the Core.

ac7801aa-0110-4746-b7ad-006a07250b3e: Hero damage of 1398 per minute on a 1225 norm, plus first blood. A duo-lane kill on Steel answered Sparrow's death; repeat that rotation once the mid outer falls.
Four of five deaths went to Aurora, plus a death to Kira outside any detected fight. When Aurora leaves the offlane, save Bramble Patch to slow the dive.
6876530b-c098-48ac-8e35-3baad5b4144f: A mid kill on Steel preceded two inner towers and a Valmont kill preceded two inhibitors; also razed the mid inner. Once the duo outer falls, repeat the trip.
CS of 4.3 per minute on a 7.3 norm, and two of three deaths to Kira in the enemy duo half. While Kira is ahead, farm under tower.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Zero deaths, the most healing of all ten players at 10670, and 11965 gold to 9333 for Aurora. When the team groups next, soak the first engage.
Hero damage 427 per minute on a 553 norm, one kill and one assist. Once the offlane outer falls, bring Stone Forged Soul to the next mid fight.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Hero damage 14158, second of all ten behind The Fey, with both kills on Kira. When Kira commits, save the Neural Disruptor silence for Kira.
8 wards on a 9.6 norm while Steel placed 14, and the enemy cleared five wards to the team's two. Before each Fangtooth, ward the pit approaches first.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Objective damage 15161, the most of all ten players, plus four kills on Bayle and the mid inhibitor razed. After each Bayle kill, invade the enemy jungle.
Kira scored three of five deaths, including a mid death shortly before enemy Fangtooth and the game's last kill. While Kira lives, dive only beside Sparrow.

matchup: Mid opponent Valmont finished 0/12/4; Khaimera added four kills on Valmont to the mid pressure.
Aurora was the real threat to The Fey: Hoarfrost roots, and Cryoseism slows, then stuns.
Bayle healed 10492 and Steel 5669, so anti-heal had real targets.
build: Tainted Scepter cuts the target's healing on magical damage, the right answer to Steel and Bayle.
Soulbinder adds bonus damage only when abilities hit heroes from long range; Combustion in the field core needs no range.
Timewarp, finished last, trims non-ultimate cooldowns over time; earlier fights ran without Timewarp.
eternal: Aion grants mana regeneration on spell casts and gold from spell damage on heroes.
Lotus and Demiurge are a toss-up in The Fey mid field, Aion third; Bottomless Vial with Runic Focus tops Aion pairs.
augment: Wild Growth gives Bramble Patch more range.
Verdant Embrace is clearly the best in The Fey mid field, ahead of Wild Growth.
crest: Soulbearer's active grants a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed briefly.
Soulbearer is clearly the best crest in The Fey mid field. Sound keep.
improvement: Verdant Embrace over Wild Growth is the field-backed swap: Untamed Growth also heals The Fey and allies, giving up Bramble Patch range.
No item change is proven; the damage already led the game.

matchup: Duo was Sparrow and Lt. Belica against Kira and Steel; each duo lost two deaths before minute ten.
Kira went 7/4/1, half the enemy kills, and out-earned Sparrow 10981 gold to 9508.
Steel's Force Shield wall destroys enemy projectiles and slows; Bull Rush and Shield Bash stun.
build: Deathstalker shreds physical armor on basic attacks against heroes and adds attack speed.
Vanquisher executes heroes taken below a small health threshold.
Viper, finished last, reduces physical armor on hero damage; earlier fights ran without Viper.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage projectiles on damaging a low-health hero; Forage adds gold and XP per minion or monster kill.
Thraex leans ahead of Weald in the Sparrow carry field; Forage with Wind-Rider is the best Weald pair, as run.
augment: Endless Hunt resets basic ability cooldowns on takedowns and permanently adds physical penetration.
Sun Shards leans ahead of Endless Hunt in the Sparrow carry field.
crest: Liberator's active cleanses debuffs and grants a short shield.
Pacifier is clearly the best crest in the Sparrow carry field; Liberator ranks behind.
improvement: Pacifier for Liberator is the field-backed crest swap: a dash and an empowered physical hit, giving up the cleanse and shield.
Sun Shards for Endless Hunt is a field lean: ricocheting basic attacks, giving up takedown cooldown resets.

matchup: Aurora was the lane opponent, 5/1/1, with four kills on The Fey and none on Greystone.
Aurora's Glacial Charge leaves a walkable wall; Boreal Sweep slows and Hoarfrost roots.
Greystone's only kill was on Bayle, on the offlane in the enemy half.
build: Overlord cleaves basic attack damage around the target and stacks permanent health from kills.
Rapture adds on-hit damage to basic attacks while close to an enemy unit.
Aegis Of Agawar, finished last, adds armor and magical armor, doubled at low health; earlier fights lacked Aegis.
eternal: Krix raises maximum health by level; Regenerative Tissue regenerates after time without hero damage, Cannibalism adds health on takedowns.
Krix and Xyris are a toss-up in the Greystone offlane field; Voracity with Feeding Frenzy is the best Krix pair.
augment: Tainted Oath makes Sacred Oath apply Blight to enemies.
Imperial Soul is clearly the best in the Greystone offlane field; Tainted Oath ranks third, behind Close Cut.
crest: Judgement's active deals area damage and heals on hero hits.
Iceskorn Talons and Brutallax lead a toss-up in the Greystone offlane field; Judgement, the most played, ranks behind both.
improvement: Imperial Soul over Tainted Oath is the field-backed swap: Stone Forged Soul hits harder and wider, giving up Blight on Sacred Oath.
Iceskorn Talons for Judgement stays on the Champion Crest path: an ice sheet buffing allies, giving up the heal.

matchup: Kira and Steel were the duo pair; the lone Lt. Belica death came to Kira, none to Steel.
Steel's Shield Slam knocks up and stuns, and Bull Rush is unstoppable during the dash.
Kill participation reached 35%, with a rotation kill on Kira at mid right after The Fey fell.
build: Wraith Leggings makes abilities deal bonus magical damage to heroes at low health.
Combustion hits the target and nearby enemies on ability damage.
Tainted Scepter, finished last, cuts healing on magical damage, a second anti-heal source beside The Fey's Tainted Scepter.
eternal: Vesh turns a share of ability damage on heroes into damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage.
Lotus is clearly the best in the Lt. Belica support field; Vesh ranks near the bottom.
Tithe of Death with Mind Rot, as run, is the best Vesh pair.
augment: Combat Veteran adds movement speed and passive experience each second, scaling with hero level.
Combat Veteran leans ahead of Devastating Bombs in the Lt. Belica support field. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer's active is a shield with magical lifesteal and movement speed, built off the Wizard Crest path.
Soulbearer has too few games to lead in the Lt. Belica support field; Reclamation and Tranquility lead a toss-up.
improvement: Reclamation over Soulbearer adds a team cleanse and a higher ward cap, giving up the shield and lifesteal.
Lotus over Vesh is the clear field call: random stat gains over time and on takedowns, giving up the damage over time.

matchup: Bayle was the jungle opponent and finished 0/5/2, four of those deaths to Khaimera.
Valmont was the gank target: four Khaimera kills, three on the mid lane.
Bayle's Cursed Edge third slash knocks up and stuns; Kingslayer uppercuts a hero into the air.
build: Overlord splashes basic attack damage around the target, strong on camps and grouped enemies.
Sky Splitter deals a share of the target's current health on basic attacks, best against high-health targets.
Draconum and Rapture, the rest of the field's winning core, never arrived; the game ended at two items.
eternal: Lotus grants a random stat every two minutes and on takedowns; Early Bloom adds a level, Immaculate cuts damage at high health.
Lotus leans first in the Khaimera jungle field; Masterpiece with Prima Donna is the best Lotus pair.
augment: Jungle Invasion grants physical power in the jungle, doubled in the enemy jungle.
Jungle Invasion is clearly the best in the Khaimera jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Judgement's active hits an area and heals on hero hits, each hero hit after the first healing half as much.
Eviscerator is clearly the best crest in the Khaimera jungle field; Judgement ranks well behind.
improvement: Eviscerator for Judgement is the field-backed crest pick: attack speed, omnivamp and empowered basics, giving up the area heal.
Masterpiece with Prima Donna over the run pair trades the extra level and damage reduction for kill-stacking damage, taking more damage.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Steel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
ourKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
ourKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
ourKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
ourKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
enemyKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam
